name: Innyuu Ningyou ~Genmu no Yujuku "Kitsune no Mori" Yawa~
original_name: 淫乳人形～幻夢の湯宿「狐の杜」夜話～
source:
"Fox Grove", one of Japan's premier hot spring inns. The source of its hot springs flows through a parallel dimension that is the homeland of youkai. Consequently, the entire inn area suffers from dimensional instability. 

The yokai cannot maintain physical forms and wander in a soul-like state, sometimes causing mischief to the inn's guests... Therefore, it had become customary at this inn to perform a ritual once a year to appease these youkai.

And now, that time has come again this year. This time, it seems a newcomer “Pacifier (Puppeteer)” will perform the ritual, causing some unease. Unexpected incidents during this ritual are not uncommon.

Will this new Pacifier (the protagonist) be able to successfully pacify the youkai?

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item9240/af-765?af_type=1&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
translation:
“狐之杜”是日本首屈一指的温泉旅馆之一。这里的温泉水源流经另一个维度，那里正是妖怪们的故乡。因此，整片旅馆区域的维度都不太稳定。

妖怪们无法维持实体，只能以类似魂魄的形态游荡，有时还会捉弄旅馆的客人…因此，每年举行一次仪式，安抚这些妖怪，便成了旅馆的惯例。

今年，举行仪式的时节又到了。据说这次将由一位新手“镇抚师（傀儡师）”主持，难免令人有些担忧。毕竟，仪式中发生意想不到的状况，并不是什么稀罕事。

这位新手镇抚师，也就是主角，究竟能否顺利安抚妖怪们呢？

[摘自[url=https://gyutto.com/i/item9240/af-765?af_type=1&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
